notes: Free starter Skiff so every account can buy/ship/sell commodities instantly (scaled off the Courier row: 2,500u hold, +3% risk, zero cost; not purchasable, it is the floor). Commodity-haul interception rebalanced via simulation so the riskiest unescorted hauls land in a 45-50% band with a hard 50% backstop: value scaling cap +7% (was +15%), fly-by 2.5%/hop, lane factor x0.35, tension /1800, blockade +6%, final clamp 0.50, 3% residual floor. Lane ordering corporate->dark preserved; sim median ~18%, p99 39%. Guard escorts (Light/Armed Convoy/Private Army, same tiers as smuggling) added to the shipping console, priced as a percent of cargo value, baked into the roll and lost if intercepted. P&L position lists and %-move bars now sortable by sector (personal + Capital House guild).
